race.comment: ADMIRE ASTRA (1) was solid behind an impressive winner last start over this track and trip, but she now has the fitness base to explode third-up. Tsang's claim comes in handy and she can sit up front from the outset. At her peak now and she can go one better in this suitable event. STREAMLINED (4) gets Pike back on board today after failing over 2200m when stretching to that distance last week. His run at this trip prior was solid when a $3 chance and he's sure to feature in the finish once again. I'M NIPOTE (6) is racing in good order and can't be left out of calculations. SPANK APPEAL (9) is ticking along nicely without winning and won't be far away.
